newsitem.title: UK: Stagecoach to expand buses in Glasgow.
newsitem.headline: Stagecoach to expand buses in Glasgow.

text.p: British transport group Stagecoach Holdings Plc said on Monday it would open new routes in Glasgow, Scotland, where it will invest 10 million pounds.
The transport group said that the expansion, which will start on April 24, will create 250 new jobs in the next twelve months in the Glasgow area.

"The recent monopolies commission decision requiring FirstBus to sell a part of its operations in Glasgow has demonstrated the regulator's determination to encourage competition," said Brian Souter, chairman of Stagecoach.
"We are responding to this with new innovative bus services in Strathclyde designed to attract new bus users by offering faster journey times and wider choice," he added.
Britain's Department of Trade and Industry ordered FirstBus Plc to dispose of some of its Glasgow operation following the purchase of Scottish bus company SB Holdings Ltd.
